Alireza Javan <support@avicennaresearch.com>:
Dear Karen, According to the audit logs, it appears that sessions were generated for participant 99526 beginning on September 7th. This issue arose because the app was force-stopped by the OS (Xiaomi MIUI). When the app started again on that date, the server detected it as being active and created the sessions from September 7th onwards.To avoid this issue in the future, please be aware that Xiaomi MIUI has a feature that prevents apps from running in the background by default and will force-stop them. If you are using a Xiaomi device, you can allow the app to run in the background by following these steps:Go to Settings > Apps > Avicenna app > App permissions > Background autostartOr go to Settings > Permissions > AutoStart > enable auto-start for the appEnsuring that the app runs in the background will prevent the OS from force-stopping the app. Additionally, please disable battery optimization for the app on your device.
